description: Named the reMarkable PDF 'GeniusSpark_MeetingPrep' using underscore slug format instead of the human-readable naming convention defined in agents/conventions.md for deliverable files. Should have been 'GeniusSpark Meeting Prep.pdf' — no dates, no underscores, human-readable.
correction: Deliverable files (HTML, PDF, PPTX) destined for reading/sharing use human-readable names with no dates and no underscores. Convention example: 'Account Name Brief.pdf'. Source markdown files use the slug pattern; deliverables do not.
systemic_fix: Read agents/conventions.md before naming any deliverable file, not just source files. The naming rules differ by file type and destination.
